questions.title: What is the main difference between global scope and local scope in JavaScript?
answers: Global variables are declared with let, and local variables with const.
Global variables are accessible from anywhere, local variables are not.
Global scope is for functions, and local scope is for objects.

questions.title: Variable shadowing is when an inner scope variable with the same name as an outer variable hides the outer variable.
What is a key advantage of arrow functions (`=>`)?
answers: They can be used as constructors.
They have their own arguments object.
They provide a more concise syntax for writing function expressions.
They are hoisted to the top of their scope.

questions.title: What is the purpose of rest parameters (...) in a function definition?
answers: To spread the elements of an array into individual arguments.
To collect an indefinite number of arguments into an array.
To set a default value for a parameter.
To create a shallow copy of an object.

questions.title: If an object is passed to a function, a copy is made, so modifications inside the function don't affect the original.
Which method is used to create a new element in the DOM?
What is the purpose of the <template> element in HTML?
answers: To define a new CSS style.
To create a new JavaScript function.
To hold client-side content that is not rendered but can be used later.
To create a form for user input.

questions.title: Event delegation is the practice of attaching an event listener to each individual element in a list.

What is the primary difference between Object.keys() and a for...in loop?
answers: Object.keys() returns values, while for...in iterates over keys.

questions.title: Object destructuring allows you to extract properties from an object and assign them to variables with the same name.
In array destructuring, how can you skip elements?
answers: It's not possible to skip elements.
